description: Clean a table string by trimming cells, dropping empty rows, and deduplicating rows. Use when preparing data for analysis; NOT for transforming data types. Use convert_table to change data types.

dedupe.description: Set true to enable dedupe; false otherwise.

drop_empty_rows.description: Set true to enable drop empty rows; false otherwise.

trim.description: Set true to enable trim; false otherwise.

name: clean_table

cleaned_data.description: The cleaned table string with trimmed cells, empty rows dropped, and duplicate rows removed.

rows_dropped.description: The number of empty rows that were dropped from the table.

rows_duplicated.description: The number of duplicate rows that were removed from the table.

title: Clean table
